WITH web_dispatch AS (
    SELECT web_order_id,
           CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
    FROM fact_web_order
    WHERE status IN ('delivered', 'collected')
),
net_lines AS (
    SELECT COALESCE(w.dispatch_date, f.sale_date) AS business_date, s.store_id, f.net_amount AS net_sales
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    LEFT JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT r.return_date, s.store_id, -r.refund_net
    FROM fact_return_line r
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = r.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
)
SELECT d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_week, SUM(n.net_sales) AS net_sales, SUM(CASE WHEN n.store_id=900 THEN n.net_sales ELSE 0 END) AS web
FROM net_lines n JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = n.business_date
WHERE d.fiscal_period = 2 AND d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2025/26','FY2026/27')
GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 2,1

WITH dups AS (
  SELECT receipt_id, line_no FROM fact_sales_line
  GROUP BY 1,2 HAVING COUNT(*)>1
)
SELECT f.sale_date, f.sales_line_id, f.receipt_id, f.line_no, f.store_key, f.product_key, f.quantity, f.net_amount, f.channel_code, f.etl_loaded_at
FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dups d USING (receipt_id, line_no)
ORDER BY f.receipt_id, f.line_no, f.sales_line_id LIMIT 24

WITH dups AS (
  SELECT receipt_id, line_no, COUNT(*) c FROM fact_sales_line
  GROUP BY 1,2 HAVING COUNT(*)>1
)
SELECT d.c, MIN(f.sale_date), MAX(f.sale_date), COUNT(*), COUNT(DISTINCT CAST(f.etl_loaded_at AS DATE)) etl_days, MIN(f.etl_loaded_at), MAX(f.etl_loaded_at)
FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dups d USING (receipt_id, line_no) GROUP BY 1

SELECT d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_week, SUM(CASE WHEN r.store_id<900 THEN r.net_sales END) stores, SUM(CASE WHEN r.store_id=900 THEN r.net_sales END) web, SUM(CASE WHEN r.store_id NOT IN (999) THEN r.net_sales END) total_ex999, SUM(CASE WHEN r.store_id=999 THEN r.net_sales END) s999
FROM rpt_daily_store_sales r JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=r.business_date
WHERE d.fiscal_period=2 AND d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2025/26','FY2026/27')
GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 2,1

SELECT d.fiscal_year, d.calendar_date, d.day_name, d.is_trading_day, d.holiday_name, COUNT(DISTINCT s.store_id) stores_trading, SUM(f.net_amount) net_lines
FROM dim_date d
LEFT JOIN fact_sales_line f ON f.sale_date=d.calendar_date AND f.channel_code='ST' OR (f.sale_date=d.calendar_date AND f.channel_code IS NULL)
LEFT JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key
WHERE d.fiscal_period=2 AND d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2025/26','FY2026/27') AND d.fiscal_week IN (7,8)
GROUP BY 1,2,3,4,5 ORDER BY 1,2

SELECT d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_week, s.store_id=999 AS is999, p.category='ZZ Test' AS is_test, COUNT(*) n, SUM(f.net_amount) net
FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=f.sale_date
WHERE d.fiscal_period=2 AND d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2025/26','FY2026/27') AND (s.store_id=999 OR p.category='ZZ Test')
GROUP BY 1,2,3,4 ORDER BY 1,2,3,4

WITH web_dispatch AS (
    SELECT web_order_id,
           CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
    FROM fact_web_order
    WHERE status IN ('delivered', 'collected')
),
net_lines AS (
    SELECT COALESCE(w.dispatch_date, f.sale_date) AS business_date, f.net_amount AS net_sales
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    LEFT JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT r.return_date, -r.refund_net
    FROM fact_return_line r
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = r.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
),
weekly AS (
    SELECT d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_week, SUM(n.net_sales) AS net_sales
    FROM net_lines n
    JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = n.business_date
    WHERE d.fiscal_period = 2 AND d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2026/27', 'FY2025/26')
    GROUP BY 1, 2
)
SELECT 'FY2026/27' AS fiscal_year, 2 AS fiscal_period, ty.fiscal_week,
       ROUND(ty.net_sales, 2) AS net_sales, 'FY2025/26' AS comparison_fiscal_year,
       ROUND(ly.net_sales, 2) AS net_sales_last_year,
       ROUND(100.0 * (ty.net_sales / ly.net_sales - 1), 1) AS growth_pct
FROM weekly ty
JOIN weekly ly ON ly.fiscal_week = ty.fiscal_week AND ly.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26'
WHERE ty.fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27'
ORDER BY ty.fiscal_week
